entities.name: New Culture Collective
entities.description: A political party on Avishkar, formerly a rebel faction under the Consulate, made of engineers, students, laborers and other radicals.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The repressive government the NCC opposed and later toppled.

entities.name: Ghirapur Sprint
entities.description: The Collective's most popular and dangerous race, used for recruiting.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: City where the NCC first came together.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion at whose onset the NCC suspended anti-government activity.

entities.name: Indigo Revolution
entities.description: Revolution in which the NCC and allies toppled the Consulate.

entities.name: Avishkar Assembly
entities.description: Legislature where the NCC holds a plurality of seats.

events.summary: The NCC first came together in Ghirapur as a hotbed of revolutionary ideologies.
events.quote: The New Culture Collective first came together in Ghirapur

events.summary: At the onset of the New Phyrexian Invasion the NCC suspended anti-government activities to defend the plane.
events.quote: the NCC suspended its anti-government activities and shifted its focus to the defense of the plane

events.summary: After the Invasion the NCC and allies quickly toppled the Consulate in the Indigo Revolution.
events.quote: the Consulate was quickly and nearly bloodlessly toppled by the NCC and allied factions in the Indigo Revolution

relations.quote: They were formerly a rebel faction during the rule of the Consulate .
